title: Dune or Avengers? They Open the SAME Day 🎬 #shorts
description:
Dune or Avengers? Comment which one wins.

Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three both open on 18 December in the US. Last time two giants shared a weekend, we got Barbenheimer.

Sources: GamesRadar+ (Robert Downey Jr. 'Dunesday', IMAX), SlashFilm, ABC News (tracking, 25 Nov 2026), TheWrap (Barbenheimer final figures)
